topology_overlay.rule: The inventory matches the final canonical-data-model authority directly; deferred_tables remain forbidden and required_tables remain mandatory.

type_contract.id_generation: Application-generated UUIDv7 preferred; gen_random_uuid() type-compatible fallback; no integer/public_id pair
type_contract.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP at the application boundary; posted totals persisted at 2 decimal places

tenant_contract.tenant_primary_key: Addressable tenant aggregates, events and ledger facts use PRIMARY KEY (org_id, id); pure non-addressable associations and rebuildable projections use an org_id-leading natural composite primary key without id
tenant_contract.global_primary_key: PRIMARY KEY (id) only for organizations, global core.users, and global references
tenant_contract.index_rule: Do not add a redundant UNIQUE (org_id,id) or single-column tenant id index; add only proven access-path indexes after the composite primary key
tenant_contract.child_fk: Every tenant child and actor FK includes org_id; actor evidence references retained core.memberships rows
tenant_contract.rls: ENABLE and FORCE RLS on every direct/inherited tenant table; core.organizations and core.users use membership-based FORCE RLS despite global keys
tenant_contract.runtime_ownership: erp_runtime and erp_app own no application relation and have NOBYPASSRLS

identity_contract.profile: core.users has its own uuid primary key and nullable globally unique auth_user_id referencing auth.users(id)
identity_contract.membership: core.memberships is unique by (org_id,user_id), allowing one profile in many organizations
identity_contract.authorization: core.role_permissions and core.access_grants are relational; permission or branch arrays/JSON are prohibited

cardinality_contract: Organization 1:M branches, memberships, roles, settings, sequences, idempotency, audit, and outbox
auth.users 1:0..1 core.users through globally unique auth_user_id
Party 0:1 customer account and 0:1 supplier account; party 1:M contacts, addresses, tax registrations
Every sales/procurement header 1:M typed lines; no polymorphic commerce document table
Order line 1:M dispatch/invoice lines; invoice line M:N dispatch line through sales.invoice_dispatch_allocations with allocated base quantity
Purchase order line 1:M goods receipt lines; supplier invoice line M:N goods receipt line through procurement.supplier_invoice_receipt_allocations with allocated base quantity
Inventory document 1:M lines; line 1:M immutable stock ledger entries
One finance.accounting_event identifies exactly one typed business source and exactly one journal entry; journal entry 1:M journal lines
Payment/open item M:N through finance.allocations; withholding/open item is 1:1 through the same exact-source settlement fact
Tax document M:N filed return through tax.return_documents; portal document 1:M immutable portal document lines; reconciliation run 1:M items
Product M:N ingredient through catalog.product_ingredients with typed strength and UOM
Product recall M:N batch through compliance.recall_batches
Agent grant 1:M command requests; command request 1:M append-only approval decisions
One idempotency claim 1:1 calculation artifact; each artifact identifies exactly one typed sales or procurement aggregate and is consumed at most once by its posting command
regulated_invariants: Sales and procurement remain separate typed aggregates because their required fields, posting rules, and lineage differ.
Posted invoice, supplier invoice, journal, payment, stock, tax filing, and compliance facts are corrected only through linked reversal/adjustment records.
Invoice totals equal persisted line-level taxable, discount, charge, and GST component snapshots using explicit decimal rounding.
Journal entries balance functional-currency debit and credit before posting; transaction-currency amount and exchange rate are separate snapshots.
Exactly one accounting event owns each posted journal entry and each event identifies one typed source document.
Stock balances store on-hand quantity rebuilt only from posted stock ledger entries; available quantity subtracts active reservations in a read model.
Inventory documents with type stock_count preserve count evidence and post only approved variance lines; separate stock-count tables are prohibited in v1.
Allocations have one owner, finance.allocations, exactly one payment/withholding source, and cannot exceed source or open-item amounts under concurrent writes.
Tax documents preserve net value, GST taxable value, exact components, zero-rated mode, recipient liability, organization self-assessed tax, counterparty payable and signed adjustment lineage.

Income-tax TDS and GST TDS are typed tax.withholdings facts with governing provision, basis, rate, components, deposit/report evidence, journal and settlement allocation; section 206C(1H) sales TCS is not modeled after its 2025-04-01 cessation.
Filed tax returns reference immutable tax.documents, never journal entries; portal imports retain immutable row-level evidence in tax.portal_document_lines.
E-invoice and e-way bill sources are constrained tax documents covering the supported statutory document types, including credit/debit notes and delivery challans.
Filed tax returns and closed fiscal periods reject mutation; corrections are append-only linked artifacts.
Idempotency is unique by (org_id, actor_membership_id, operation, idempotency_key); same hash returns the first result and a changed hash conflicts.
Document numbers are allocated atomically after idempotency ownership and are retained on cancellation.
Agent grants bind Auth profile, client, organization, optional branch, capabilities, expiry, and revocation.
Command request and approval state is durable relational data separate from idempotency and audit.
REST and MCP invoke the same application command/query handlers and transaction boundary.

Calculation artifacts bind exact canonical input/output bytes, engine/ruleset/serializer versions, tenant, branch, actor, request, idempotency and aggregate version; runtime roles cannot write or consume them directly.

required_before_revision: Every table has a reviewed column/type/default/nullability contract
Every FK has explicit cardinality, tenant composite key, and delete behavior
Every status has an allowed-transition matrix and terminal-state immutability rule
Every index is justified by a tenant-first query or uniqueness invariant
Every table is classified direct tenant, inherited tenant, global reference, event, or projection
Every source API/UI/MCP operation is mapped or explicitly retired in app-data-contract.json
All 20 deferred table names are absent and all 27 required canonical facts have reviewed column and constraint contracts
Global-key core.organizations and core.users have reviewed membership-based FORCE RLS policies
Every created/updated/posted/approved actor column is a composite tenant FK to a retained core.memberships row
baseline_generation_gates.revision_policy: One reviewed empty-database baseline; no IF NOT EXISTS; no application table in public
